notes: Completion of the 2026-10-08 weekly run after the prior attempt stopped before evidence freeze; the Consensus Evidence Backbone was rerun on 2026-10-09 after the connector update.
All nine radars were searched across Consensus, freshness, and frontier layers. R7-R9 remained quiet for qualifying new empirical evidence and were not padded with weaker material.
G02 is narrowed because a four-wave, school-year study adds repeated real-world evidence from working teachers, but it does not measure durable expert capability after AI withdrawal.

G03 is narrowed because the same study separates generative-layer from formulation-layer offloading and embeds a human-first micro-randomized comparison, but independent capability retention remains unresolved.
